title: Two Coworkers Plan a Weekend Camping Trip
script: Dewi: [excited] Fajar, I've been thinking about that camping trip we talked about. Are you still free this weekend?
Fajar: [smiling] Yes, definitely. I already checked the weather, and it looks clear until Sunday evening.
Dewi: [curious] Perfect. Where should we go? Somewhere near the lake, or up in the hills?
Fajar: [thoughtful] I like the lake spot. There's a quiet campsite there with a good view of the water at sunrise.
Dewi: [pleased] That sounds beautiful. Have you camped there before?
Fajar: [warmly] Once, last year. I woke up early and watched the mist rising off the water. It was completely silent, just birds calling.
Dewi: [thoughtful] Now I really want to go. What should I bring that people usually forget?
Fajar: [helpfully] A warm jacket, honestly. It gets surprisingly cold near the water at night, even in dry season.
Dewi: [surprised] Really? I was only planning for the daytime heat.
Fajar: [nodding] Everyone makes that mistake the first time. I'll also bring a small stove so we can make hot tea in the morning.
Dewi: [excited] That sounds wonderful, actually. Anything else I should pack?
Fajar: [thinking] A flashlight, definitely, and maybe a book, since there's no signal there for your phone anyway.
Dewi: [laughing] No signal sounds like a relief, honestly. I could use two days without messages.
Fajar: [agreeing] Same here. I always sleep better after a weekend without a screen near my face.
Dewi: [curious] What time should we leave on Saturday?
Fajar: [confidently] Early, around six, so we can set up the tent before the sun gets too strong.
Dewi: [determined] Alright, six it is. I'll bring the food if you bring the tent and stove.
Fajar: [warmly] Deal. I think this trip is exactly what this tired week has been missing.
Dewi: [smiling] Same here. I can already imagine that quiet lake in the morning.
